notes: *were without number* is read as the existential אַיִן with its copula, headed on *without* (rule 50); the לְ of לִגְמַלֵּיהֶם is unrepresented because its object becomes the English subject (rule 40).
In *the sea shore* the article on הַיָּם takes the written *the* standing before its own word, the construct being rendered attributively (rules 28, 29).
